<a id="act_wall_bump"></a>
### [`act_wall_bump`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L104) `$24B7`

*label*

Wall bump (state $18, timer 64). When the actor is out of the wall the state ends at the next step. While it is still in the wall the older moves are undone record by record (actor_undo_last_moves). When the move history is empty, the room restarts through enter_room with Bruce at the room's start point A (spawn_a_x/spawn_a_y), also when the stuck actor is an enemy.

- **Jumped to from:** [`actor_action_step`](actor_step.md#actor_action_step)

<a id="actor_continue_state"></a>
### [`actor_continue_state`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L143) `$24F4`

*routine*

State setter for a running timed action: actor_state,X = A, step delay from actor_state_step_delay, actor_timer,X = temp_y - 1.

- **Jumped to from:** [`actor_continue_action`](actor_timed_actions.md#actor_continue_action), [`yamo_start_pose`](actor_timed_actions.md#yamo_start_pose), [`actor_recover`](actor_timed_actions.md#actor_recover), [`$235F`](../../../../src/actor/enemy_ai_states.asm#L77), [`$23FC`](../../../../src/actor/enemy_ai_states.asm#L173), [`$2404`](../../../../src/actor/enemy_ai_states.asm#L177), [`$240B`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L8), [`$242B`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L27), [`$243A`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L34), [`$248A`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L78), [`$24AD`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L94), [`$24B5`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L99) and 1 more
